Aah, I missed one item @sanjayradadiya - you need to look out for `datetime` as well as `datetime-local`, `date`, and `time`:
https://github.com/json-editor/json-editor#format

@sanjayradadiya - we still have a bit to do here, please:
https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/940#issuecomment-884932925

Hello @sanjayradadiya   - I've modified the `weather` template in `TallMsg` to include a range of date and datetime control types.  You'll need to pull the branch to get the new `weather` template.

`datetime-local` is working, but not `datetime`.   No popup appears.  The others all work fine :-)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/127011479-9f9f3256-1368-46cf-861c-186f124693e1.png)

> Hello @sanjayradadiya - I've modified the `weather` template in `TallMsg` to include a range of date and datetime control types. You'll need to pull the branch to get the new `weather` template.
> 
> `datetime-local` is working, but not `datetime`. No popup appears. The others all work fine :-)
> 
> ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/127011479-9f9f3256-1368-46cf-861c-186f124693e1.png)

HTML5 supports only date, time, datetime-local which is mentioned in the below link.
	https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/datetime-local

@json-editor/json-editor has mentioned datetime and datetime-local in the below link.
	https://github.com/json-editor/json-editor#format

both datetime and datetime-local are pointed to the same format like "datetime-local" mentioned in the below link. they didn't use "datetime" format anywhere.
	Code: https://github.com/json-editor/json-editor/blob/master/docs/datetime.html#L156
	View: https://json-editor.github.io/json-editor/datetime.html

Hey, well-researched @sanjayradadiya  :-)

Could you remove the (mistaken) support for `datetime` in the PR please, and I'll get it merged?

@sanjayradadiya  - we to string comparison above, then we do it again in the switch block in `configCommonProps `

I'm pretty sure we can remove this `if` construct, can't we?
in the above line, we pass in an array of items.  Will this still work with the `configDateTimeLocal` method?  (it looks like that only processes one line at a time)

@sanjayradadiya  - doesn't line 106 overwrite any changes made in line 104?

(same in other catch blocks)

Yes, you are right.
I have two options at that time.
1) function should be called every time irrespective of format
2) function should be called only if we have format datetime or date or time
I choose option 2 and I will change it to option 1.

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/blob/develop/packages/client/src/Schemas/DailyIntentions.json#L3

Yes, but don't we need to provide iterator for `array`?

Json Schema Editor specification mentioned that {"type":"array"} will take array in "items.properties" which is ultimately an object which is mentioned in image 1.
Aah, I see.  That's fine then :-D
option 2 changed to option 1 in latest commit.
